description: Update SuperAdminCenter.tsx to make all admin tabs fully functional with real API data - Event Approvals (from DB), Audit Logs (with filters), enhanced Gallery (content safety status), and Applications (with approve/reject actions)
steps: Update Event Approvals tab: Replace hardcoded initialEvents with API fetch from GET /api/admin/events. Add approve/reject handlers that call PATCH /api/admin/events/:id/approve and PATCH /api/admin/events/:id/reject. Show pending/approved/rejected status from DB.

Update Audit Logs tab: Add filter controls for user (text input), action type (dropdown from actionColors keys), and date range (date pickers). Fetch from GET /api/admin/audit-logs?user=X&action=Y&from=Z&to=W. Keep the existing table rendering style.

Update Gallery tab: After upload completes, call POST /api/content/analyze with the image URL. Show safety_status badge (approved/pending/rejected) on each gallery image. If content is flagged as unsafe, show a warning and mark it.

Update Applications tab: Add Approve/Reject/Mark as Reviewed buttons to each application row. Call PATCH /api/admin/applications/:id with { status: 'approved'|'rejected'|'reviewed' }. Show action buttons only for pending applications.
Ensure all new imports compile (lucide-react icons already imported). Keep bilingual t(en, mr) pattern for all new UI text.
acceptance_criteria: Event Approvals tab fetches from API and approve/reject calls backend
Audit Logs tab has working filters for user, action type, and date range
Gallery tab shows safety_status on images and triggers content analysis on upload
Applications tab has functional approve/reject/reviewed buttons
